Android 17 (codenamed Cinnamon Bun) is the seventeenth major release and the 24th version of the Android mobile operating system, developed by the Open Handset Alliance led by Google. The first public beta was released on February 13, 2026. It was released to the public on June 16, 2026. The first devices to ship with Android 17 are the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series, and the Galaxy Z Flip 8.
[…]
Since Android 14 QPR2 shifted the development process to a trunk-based development model, build IDs in 2024 began with the letter A (e.g., AP1A, AP2A). In 2025, Google changed the starting letter to B, making the internal codename for Android 16 "Baklava", a dessert starting with B. Following this alphabetical progression, Android 17 in 2026 adopted "Cinnamon Bun", starting with the letter C, as its development codename.
[…]
The traditional Developer Previews have been discontinued beginning with Android 17 and replaced by continuously updated Android Canary builds. This shift marks the start of an “always-on” testing approach for the Android platform, in which new builds are made available on an ongoing basis rather than through a separate, time-limited preview program.
[…]
Android 17’s development cycle will not end immediately after its official release in June. According to the release schedule, the platform will follow a model that includes a major release in the second quarter, followed by a minor SDK release in the fourth quarter. Android 17 will also continue to receive updates through Quarterly Platform Releases (QPRs).
[…]
Google later clarified that Android 17 QPR1, planned for the third quarter of 2026, would include a minor SDK release. The company explained that some features could not wait until QPR2, so they would be delivered earlier through QPR1 instead.
[…]
Android version history

Android 17 (codenome Cinnamon Bun) é a décima sétima versão principal do Android, o sistema operacional móvel desenvolvido pela Open Handset Alliance sob a liderança do Google. O primeiro beta foi lançado em 13 de fevereiro de 2026 e a versão final foi lançada em 16 de junho de 2026.
[…]
O Google ajustou o ciclo de lançamento para novas versões do Android. A fase de testes públicos começou em 13 de fevereiro de 2026, com uma versão beta, já que as versões Canary do Android, introduzidas em junho de 2025, substituíram as prévias para desenvolvedores anteriores.
[…]
Em 16 de junho, o Google lançou a versão completa do Android 17 conforme planejado.
[…]
O Android 17 está disponível para todos os dispositivos Google Pixel a partir do Pixel 6 e superiores.
[…]
Um dos principais focos do Android 17 é a melhor adaptação de aplicativos para telas grandes e dispositivos dobráveis. Isso otimiza significativamente a multitarefa e a exibição em tablets e dispositivos dobráveis.
[…]
O Android agora oferece a opção de os aplicativos acessarem contatos selecionados, em vez de terem acesso irrestrito a todas as entradas como antes.
[…]
Visualmente, o Android 17 oferece opções adicionais, como ocultar nomes de aplicativos ou uma interface de gravação de tela redesenhada.==Referências==

Misato Katsuragi (Japanese: 葛城 ミサト, Hepburn: Katsuragi Misato) is a fictional character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion media franchise, created by animation studio Gainax. In the eponymous anime television series, Misato is head of the operations department of the special agency Nerv, and is in charge of directing and devising war strategies needed to defeat mysterious beings named Angels.
[…]
Misato has been widely popular with audiences and has appeared at the top of popularity polls. Some critics have contrasted her histrionic personality and sexual overtones with her 14-year-old subordinate and Evangelion protagonist Shinji Ikari; others have appreciated her spontaneity, tenacity, and endearment. She has also inspired merchandise and other subsequent anime characters.
[…]
At the request of Yoshiyuki Sadamoto, the series' character designer, the initial scenario was changed and Shinji Ikari, a male character, became the protagonist; ideas for the "older sister" character went into what would become Misato. As with other Neon Genesis Evangelion characters, the character's name was inspired by a Japanese Imperial Navy ship, the aircraft carrier Katsuragi, and Misato Izumi, a female character from Minako Narita's manga Aitsu.

Em 1993, foi lançada uma adaptação cinematográfica em live-action chamada de City Hunter (chinês tradicional: 城市獵人, pinyin: Sing si lip yan), é uma co-produção nipo-honconguês dirigida por Wong Jing e estrelada por Jackie Chan no papel de Ryo Saeba, Joey Wong como Kaori Makimura, Kumiko Goto como Shizuko Imamura e Chingmy Yau como Saeko Nogami. Levemente baseado no mangá a mistura de ação com comédia e o lado obcecado do personagem principal são os únicos pontos fies ao mangá.

Um novo filme chinês baseado em City Hunter foi anunciado em 2016, o filme seria dirigido pelo cineasta de Hong Kong, Stanley Tong, estrelando o ator chinês Huang Xiaoming como Ryo Saeba.
